question: Does individual/tag-associated vertical distribution shape recur across days even among slow-moving GPS observations in spatially overlapping 100m cells?

fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.source_filter: 2021 May-July UTC, provider-marked outlier excluded, speed 0-0.5 m/s, first event per bird/date/UTC 5minute bin before altitude inspection
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.daily_site: project EPSG32631, choose day modal 100m cell by x-y counts, tie deterministic lexicographic; require >=20 selected bins in modal cell before numeric altitude quality; no stationarity inference
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.height_native: height-above-msl finite between -300 and 3000m. Missing earliest event never replaced by a later event in the same 5minute bin.
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.qc_requirement: at least 0.80 finite in-range height fraction among frozen first-bin modal-cell events; report unavailable otherwise
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.donor_days: all modal-cell days with at least20 native valid heights. Days with fewer excluded from both training and evaluation.
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.evaluation: the unchanged medgull_sensitivity balanced D1 numerical kernel requires >=50 scored events per evaluation day and >=2 evaluation days per biological individual, >=10 individuals for inferential reporting
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.within_day_center: subtract day median height, same ten bins as previously evaluated flying shape: -Inf,-200,-100,-50,-25,0,25,50,100,200,+Inf m
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.same_cell_constraints: Own other-day>=10 and other-individual other-date>=10 in the identical modal 100m cell, with date exclusion, equal donor days and other bird weights and Jeffreys 0.5/bin
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.primary: D1 balanced same kernel as DELTATRACK 2021 flight analysis. D1 pooled raw score descriptive only.
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.null: 999 within-exact-date whole-session bird-label permutations, seed 20261022 per species, recompute support each permutation, record null eligible birds and all unavailable draws.
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.null_gate: at least950 of999 valid null draws and >=10 observed eligible biological individuals; report p_upper accounting for all invalid draws; Holm correction across both species, unavailable placeholder p=1
fixed_before_stationary_height_shapes.interpretation: Positive stationary ID after 100m matching implies detectable ID-associated altitude shape in low-speed records. It cannot discriminate tag noise from individual micro-perch/nest height. Negative does not rule out motion-specific tag errors.

unselected_sensitivity: 500m geometry already recorded as descriptive structural support, not an alternative primary endpoint; do not run extra grids or tune height bins based on real stationary result.
stop_rule: If support/quality/null gate fails, report unavailable, do not relax minima.
